## Hypothesis

Widening the SUPER stop and TP1, increasing LEVEL quantity, and adjusting LEVEL and TRENDLINE stops will capture more of the big moves on winner days (especially 5/04) while avoiding losses on loser days by reducing trade frequency or improving exit timing.

## Mechanism

Same v14/v15 trigger logic and quality-tier routing, but with adjusted exit parameters:
- SUPER: stop = -0.15 (from -0.20), TP1 = 0.75 (from 0.75? assumed same, but we don't have baseline)
- LEVEL: qty = 18 (from ?), stop = -0.12 (from ?), TP1 = 0.3 (from ?)
- TRENDLINE: stop = -0.06 (from ?)
Entry logic and quality-tier classification unchanged.
